literal: Peacock-feather-loaded cart-even axle-will-break that-cargo greatly exceeding if-loaded.
translation: Even the axle of a cart loaded with light peacock feathers will break, if that cargo is loaded in great excess.
modern: மயில் தோகையை ஏற்றிய வண்டியாக இருந்தாலும், அந்தப் பண்டத்தை அளவுக்கு அதிகமாக ஏற்றினால் வண்டியின் அச்சும் முறிந்து போகும்.
explanation: This couplet uses a vivid metaphor to explain the danger of accumulation and the importance of knowing limits. Peacock feathers are incredibly light individually, but when loaded onto a cart in extreme excess, their cumulative weight will snap the strong wooden axle. Similarly, even minor challenges, small enemies, or seemingly insignificant tasks can overwhelm and destroy a person if they are allowed to accumulate beyond measure.
